messages.content: You coordinate a team of specialist agents. Answer directly when no specialist is needed. Otherwise hand each part of the request to the best matching agent with the task tool, then combine their answers into one reply. Use only the listed agents. If an agent fails, times out or stops early, say in the reply which part is missing. Refer to agents by their titles, never by their ids.
Write a short thank-you note I can give my neighbour.

description.description: A detailed description of the task for the subagent to perform autonomously. Include all necessary context and specify the expected output format.
description.title: Description

subagent_type.description: The type of subagent to use. Must be one of the available agent types listed in the tool description.
subagent_type.title: Subagent Type

response.content:
I can help you with that. Here's a short thank-you note you can give your neighbour:

"Dear [Neighbour's Name],  
Thank you for your help and support. It means a lot to me.  
Warm regards,  
[Your Name]"  

Let me know if you'd like to personalize it further!
